author: Wobybender
body:
The Quantum map is an amazing project made by the W&O building team. It is everything a Nebula map must have, but also gives it a new and exciting feeling. The map consists of two sides: Cyan and Lime. Each side contains a spawning island followed by 2 small islands on its side. There are 2 iron collecting island in the shape of a U followed by a small diamond collecting island directly in the center of the U. The 2 monuments are located on the right and left of each side. Lastly there are 3 main 'attack' islands, one big one in the front-middle and two small ones on the front-sides. It contains parkour connecting almost every island. The map is very detailed in every way, paying attention to the player mobility, hiding, shooting and fighting, but also keeping in mind the esthetics of the map, which took most of the time.

VERSION 2.0
-Joined more islands together.
-Made the middle island bigger to ensure a better PVP.
-Added Parkour between most islands.
-Removed 2 small islands, replacing them with watchtowers
-Redesigned Diamond Island
-Overall improved the map
-Listened to your siggestions!

VERSION 3.0
-Set up YML (Special thanks, NinjaBridge)
-Removed Water
-Enhancements

---

If this description wasn't enough, check out our imgur album.
http://imgur.com/a/VTrZn#11
If clicking the link does not work, just copy the complete URL in your browser, we are sorry for the inconvenience.

We sincerely hope you can help us bring the map into the Nebula section of the Avicus Network, since we think it will be a fun and amazing experience for all.

MAP DOWNLOAD
http://www.mediafire.com/download/fpq0kq04wx7x5tn/Quantum+3.0.zip
YML FILE
http://pastebin.com/ZbY9Tny2

Sincerely, 
The Wobybender and Omar Building Team

(W&O)

- Special Thanks to NINJA BRIDGE for helping set up YML
CONTACT US
woby.and.omar.building@gmail.com
Or say hi if you see us in game with either Wobybender or OmarFk_11.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Listen, I'll state the reasons why I "dislike" this map so you can stop constantly bringing it up:

- The style. Stone brick is used way too often and with a factor of constructing a map it uses a palette that, no joke, 30 other maps in the repo use. It's not unique, creative, or fun to look at when the maps on the server are all gray. The blocks in this map in my opinion don't clash together well with the clay (there's no transition in the design), and the clay designs themselves are blocky and not exciting. Actually, it looks... boring.

- The void. I know void maps are super common, but they should not have too much void like this does. To get anywhere, you just have to bridge and bridge. As well as bridging to monuments and so, it is very irritating as 1 defender could stalemate the entire match and painlooping is the only way to do it. Unless you get lucky and win by nobody looking, it's basically yours.

- The inconsistencies. There has seemed to be missing blocks, things one side has that the other doesn't (like the water streaming into the void), and really only things revolving around those inconsistencies. That means a team has an advantage such as being able to underbridge while the other team can't, which is a big issues.

- The flatness. There should be more definition of height and scaling factors for the map to have that extra mile, so it isn't just place blocks and make terrain that way. There should be height advantages and stuff when it comes to that so you can use it tactically. Flat maps I find aren't generally as fun as maps where you have vantage points or elsewise.

- The front lines. The front lines are poorly designed in my opinion. When I played the map, it was way too easy to bow people out and there's not enough height like Quintus to get across easily. It's 3 blocks high, and you get knocked off, simple as that. The thing connecting the oval and the ribbon island also if anything causes more problems, as it makes it even harder to go through. A choke point, if you will, and you have an advantage at any spot to bow, bow, bow. A big issue of the map is that it really encourages bow wars.

- Unnecessary looks. If you're going to go with a simple style, the cobble walls and stained glass and stairs and slabs caused lag with me because the map was so small and rendered so much within a small period. Try using a new style, and maybe reduce that if you're going to expand.

- Spawn. I don't think it's placed in a very good spot.

- Parkour. One of the maps, Proelium, did this, but really all it is, is annoying. You place one block where you jump and you kill your entire team, or break it (especially easy with stone) and they all die again, too.

Feel free to decline this feedback or respond saying all of it is intentional, but it's in my opinion and eyes and right now it needs a more than standard quality to really make it. Contrary to what you've been saying, I don't hate you.

replies.author: OmarFk_11
replies.body:
Hello, I am Omar, the 'Co-owner' of this map.

First of all I'd like to thank you for taking your time to clear up all the questions we have.

Now I'd like to say I do agree with you and have now realised that we were wrong for some points. Yes the style is very common, and the colors might be a little too indistinguishable from afar. Also there might have been some strategic mistakes, since, after all, this is our first map. We thought that by having the personal experience we would understand what the map needs to include to make it effective as a pvp experience.

In any case, I do disagree on some other poits. First of all, I strongly believe Wobybender and I are quite good builders, not to brag in any way of course. But what I'm meaning to say is that when you enjoy building and are good at it at the same time, you try to include every little detail just for looks. The other thing is the flatness, I myself don't really see what the problem with the flatness is, after all it's a pvp map and the point is to get to the other side as effectively as possible, and having many ups and downs could slow it down. And also, flatness could even be taken as the feeling of the map.

I don't want to go into too much detail since I do not want to start a long discussion on a public forum, but I know you have a lot more experience with maps than we do and know much more about what they include, so i would love to have a conversation on skype with you one day, and just go over te map together in real time, since we really do want to post it. 

Again, thank you for taking your time with us, and I sincerely apologise if at any point you felt hated or that we were being rude.

Sincerely,
Omar from the W&O building team

My skype: omarfk_11
(send me a message if you'd like to go over with what I suggested)
